label: Day 4 — Evidence over hype (and honest boundaries)
tweets: Every AI-security product claims magic. Here are the numbers we can defend — and the boundaries we can't. Honest thread. 🧵

HOW WE TEST (most tools skip this):

1) Gold labels hand-verified on real open-source apps (1k–2.6k★)
2) Counter-proof: REMOVE a protection from real code — the tool must flag it. Silent = blind
3) Real-corpus audits on 13 web frameworks, 0 protocol-level FP

Numbers:

TS: 795 gold — Recall 98.5% (effective 100%), Precision 100%, 0 FP
Python: 729 gold — Recall 100%

Real catches: an auth bypass in a 2.6k★ app; the Day-1 plaintext-password bug
The 13 frameworks (Express Koa Hapi Fastify NestJS Next.js tRPC Gin Fiber FastAPI Django Flask Spring Boot) — each real-corpus verified, 0 FP + counter-proof.

Boundaries, stated publicly:

• static only — no runtime/APM
• C/Go/Java protocol rows: annotation-driven Beta
• TLS-level misuse: open, documented gap
